scope: Bounded continuation of PorTAL mechanisms, longer generated-answer learning, independent plasticity, teacher qualification, and a recoverability lens pilot.

portal_representability.claim: The native architecture can represent this successful adapter when alignments and four shared affine heads are fitted to its known matrices. Existing fixed spans exclude part of the learned change.
portal_representability.limits: Privileged known-adapter construction, unchanged architecture, one fixed RTE latent. Not learning from examples, old-task retention, or portability. Same previously evaluated 864-row synthetic fixture.

target_calibration.scope: 16 calibration examples per task; five passes; 20 updates; exploratory previously seen evaluation fixture
target_calibration.source_pair: The earlier native PorTAL initial/learned checkpoints were calibrated. This experiment did not transfer the newly constructed rank-8 representation witness.

long_stream.scope: Three optimization seeds on one fixed eight-task synthetic mapping and shared heldout input split. No independent task-distribution replication or real-world skill-transfer claim. Total updates/examples matched; current-task exposure differs.

plasticity.scope: Full-vocabulary next-token coded choice; validation AUC selection; fixed synthetic fixture; frozen backbone probes only, not full-backbone tensor hashing
Full-vocabulary next-token coded choice; validation AUC selection; fixed synthetic fixture; frozen backbone probes only, not full-backbone tensor hashing

plasticity_replication.conclusion: The seed-17 optimizer-reset candidate did not meet the unchanged learning-curve and retention criteria on seed 29. Replay improved retention but lowered new-task AUC. Capacity growth improved neither screen, despite cumulative adapter rank 8 to 16 to 24.

teacher.conclusion: Both predefined candidates failed whole-answer plus native-EOS qualification. Conditional learner distillation and internal composition were not started.

result.claim: Pilot estimates only. No general prediction or causal claim about internal readouts.

recoverability.conclusion: No eligible forgotten skills under the declared full-vocabulary behavior; predictor was not fitted. The original source trained and evaluated among 16 codes, which is a different acquisition contract. This run does not establish that a lens can or cannot predict recoverability.
recoverability.scope: Frozen logit lens, not a tuned lens or Jacobian lens; two source runs; coded intent classification; no general predictive or causal conclusion. Secondary code scores are descriptive and were not substituted into the primary gate.

preserved_initial_attempts.resume-20260911-plasticity-screen-s17: The 64-update acquisition gate failed (40/64 IID, 38/64 composition). Arm comparisons were not started. A subsequent logging exception made the execution status failed; the acquisition measurement is retained. The 128-update followup was chosen after that result, with unchanged gates.
preserved_initial_attempts.resume-20260911-portal-target-calibratio: Preflight rejected Hugging Face download metadata as extra model files. The corrected verifier excludes only download metadata and README while still rejecting unpinned model/tokenizer files. No training result from this attempt.
preserved_initial_attempts.resume-20260911-long-stream-s17/s29/s43: Pre-evaluation native-EOS validation incorrectly equated model end-of-text with tokenizer end-of-turn. The retry validates the assistant chat-template terminator. The predeclared tokenizer EOS and whole-answer criteria stayed unchanged.
preserved_initial_attempts.resume-20260911-lens-recoverability: Pre-model-load failure because the source bundle omitted protocol.sha256. The dispatcher now includes SHA sidecars; the sealed retry preserved the protocol.

remaining: Training PorTAL to reach the constructed solution from examples and preserving other tasks.
Target calibration of the newly reconstructed native generator; the completed transfer comparison used the earlier learned PorTAL source.
Real-world related skill transfer, repeated upgrades, and independently reproduced alternative update mechanisms such as Agent-Dice or Nested Learning.
A competent whole-answer teacher and actual persistent consolidation/internal composition.
A recoverability cohort qualified under its original output contract, followed by enough independent runs for predictive claims.
The broader inventory remains reading coverage; this wave does not reproduce all 26 research families.
